reason: Blindfold uses an adversarial proxy planner to alter actions, hide malicious steps with noise, and verify executable plans. It reports up to 53% higher attack success than baselines in simulation and on a robot arm. This is an embodied-agent jailbreak/security attack; it contributes no inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, quantization, or serving optimization.
title: Jailbreaking Embodied LLMs via Action-Level Manipulation
